data.body: PLAN_REVIEW_OUTCOME (retroactive, post-abbreviated-impl-plan): dispatched dso:plan-review on S1's 6 tasks. Verdict: REVISE_REQUESTED with 4 findings (1 critical, 3 major). On review of actual ticket descriptions: 3 of 4 findings were false positives stemming from the reviewer's reliance on the orchestrator's summary rather than the full ticket bodies. ACTUAL revisions applied: T4 (3c29-33ba-803a-4038) testing_mode UPDATE→RED. NON-revisions (findings dismissed after verifying actual state): (i) T3 PR_NUMBER extraction — T3's workflow yaml already sets PR_NUMBER: ${github.event.number} in env block, no extraction step needed for pull_request events; (ii) T6 T1 dependency — T6 already depends on T1, T3, T5 (link_uuid 5df36cd3-af24-4bbb-9e75-a357f9dc3406 predates this review); (iii) T1 spike outcomes AC — T1 already has explicit AC items for both spike (i) and spike (ii) outcomes, and Implementation Notes already document the conditional 'promote-tier3: <yes|no>' outcome. Scores: feasibility 3/5, completeness 3/5, yagni 4/5, codebase_alignment 4/5 — scores reflect summary-based assessment; post-correction the plan is materially stronger than scored. Proceeding to Phase B impl-plan dispatch for S2-S_docs with full ceremony.
